cycles.method: ot_emu executed instructions from so_draw entry to its rts, interrupts included, on development twin 878307834ad3c23a (MAIN.raw, not a unit). Package 14aea62fbfef825e2ea23cc4baf6e01a2f2b0bf44b215db28748c1a546aeae0c. One UP+NO set off to 1. Of 45 draws, 12 returned in 10 instructions while the blank was still off, 26 cleared the 1024-byte frame in 6157 with no interrupt inside the draw, and the dearest was 25033, the same clear with an interrupt inside it. An earlier run on the same image peaked at 25033 as well.

stress.method: Not accepted. On ot_emu, development twin 878307834ad3c23a, set OCTABAM, project ONEAUX, pattern 0, internal clock: PLAY set transport 0x800065b8 to 1, ten UP+NO chords ran while it stayed 1, STOP cleared it, and ten more ran after PLAY again (toggles 0 to 20). The trial reached 100 s with refusals 0 and no fault logged; it noted the CPU at 90% or more for 1 s. The Part byte stayed 0: PART+RIGHT, PART+DOWN and the PART menu did not move it, and stock's selector 0x4004a8a4(1) returned 0 because the base's part guard refused it.
